    Major retailers closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026, include
    Target, Costco, Sam's Club, Macy's, Kohl’s, ALDI, Lowe's, Best Buy, and TJX Companies (TJ Maxx, HomeGoods). Most mall-based retailers, department stores, and clothing retailers will be closed. Many pharmacies and supermarkets like Walmart and Kroger remain open. 
    Major Retailers Closed on Easter Sunday (April 5, 2026) 
    • ALDI
    • Best Buy
    • Burlington
    • Costco
    • Dick's Sporting Goods

    Other Potential Closures 
    • Banks: Most, if not all, are closed.
    • Post Offices: Closed.
    • Shipping Services: UPS and FedEx will likely be closed. 
    Stores Expected to be Open 
    • Walmart (typically open normal hours)
    • Kroger
    • Trader Joe's
    • Whole Foods
    • CVS / Walgreens
    • Petco / PetSmart
    • Ace Hardware
